Title: Password Reset
Content: You can reset your password from the account settings page.

Title: Forgot Password
Content: If you cannot remember your password, use the password recovery option.

Title: Account Login Problem
Content: If you are unable to log into your account, check your username and password.

Title: Change Email
Content: You can change your email address from your profile settings.

Title: Apply Leave
Content: Employees can apply for annual leave using the leave management system.

Title: Salary Information
Content: Employees can view their salary information from the payroll system.
